{{Quote|The overcoat is a nice touch, but white pants with toumon boots? Come back when your eyespots can perceive style.|[[Glambot]], an obnoxious TT-8L gatekeeper at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Club Caraveg]]|<ref name="NEGTD" />}}
Once constructed by [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc./Legends|Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]] for wealthy citizens and entrepreneurs, the '''TT-8L gatekeeper droid''', also known as the '''gatewatcher droid''' and nicknamed the "'''tattletale'''," was made to be the perfect surveillance system.

==Description==
The TT-8L gatekeeper [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was essentially a rounded [[Eye/Legends|eye]] on a stalk that was installed near a doorway and remained in a single position while operational. The eye was a rounded [[Glass/Legends|glass]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|optical lens]] with a movable shutter that could open and close. The droid was activated when its [[Audio sensor/Legends|audio sensors]] registered approaching footfalls. The TT-8L would then used a hidden peephole to scan the guest and match it against parameters held within its internal database. The droid would then announce the arrival to its master, seeking authorizing to either admit the visitor or request further information and observation.<ref name="EGTD" />

==History==
Serv-O-Droid marketed the TT-8L to the wealthy, positioning it as a discreet threat analyst and surveillance system. Aware that the job the droid was intended to perform could be undertaken by cheaper systems such as a [[Security camera/Legends|security holocam]], the company targeted the wealthy and the [[Noble/Legends|nobility]] because they were more used to having servants to cater to their needs. The droid soon earned the nickname of "tattletale" and over the product's lifetime, several variants were manufactured, from the menacing [[TT-8L/Y7 gatekeeper droid/Legends|TT-8L/Y7]] to the gilded [[TT-8L/XSS]].<ref name="EGTD" />

It could be modified into an [[Survey droid/Legends|advance scout droid]] by updating its programming to include piloting and mounting it to a fast vehicle.<ref name="SGD" />
